## Purpose
`/workflows`: the workflows list. It has domain filtering, sort, bulk actions, publish, archive, deployment packages, classification, run history and run-from-card.

## Responsibilities
`WorkflowsIndexPage`:
- reads `workflowsApi.list` and `ontologyApi.concepts` / `annotationsBulk`;
- `WorkflowCard`s;
- actions: `publish`, `archive` ("Workflow archived."), and `remove` in bulk;
- dialogs: `DeployPackageModal`, `WorkflowClassificationModal`, `WorkflowExecutionModal` and `HistoryPanel`;
- `DomainFilterDropdown` and `domainTree`.

Titled "Workflows — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`WorkflowsIndexPage`.

## Control flow
React Query.

## Data, state and side effects
Workflow changes.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Uses:** `components/workflows/*` and `components/ontology/*`.

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **The annotations query is keyed under `["ontology", "annotations"]`,** so saving a classification refreshes the cards.
